name: fantsec-http-mcp-wrapper
stderr:
Missing required --url.

Usage: fantsec-http-mcp-wrapper --url <remote-mcp-url> [options] [-- <mcp-remote flags...>]

Required:
  --url <url>                 Remote HTTP MCP endpoint

Wrapper options:
  --bearer-env-var <name>     Env var containing bearer token (default: MCP_BEARER_TOKEN)
  --header <name:value>       Additional header to pass through to mcp-remote (repeatable)
  --help                      Show this help message
  --version                   Show wrapper version

All other flags are forwarded to mcp-remote unchanged.

Examples:
  fantsec-http-mcp-wrapper --url https://mcp.example.com/plane/mcp --bearer-env-var MCP_PLANE_TOKEN
  fantsec-http-mcp-wrapper --url https://mcp.example.com/docmost/mcp --bearer-env-var MCP_DOCMOST_TOKEN --debug
